set.description: 只有符号不同的两个数互为相反数，在数轴上位于原点两侧且到原点距离相等，0 的相反数是 0。
set.name: Additive inverses

criteria: 能说出绝对值的几何意义
知道互为相反数的两数绝对值相等
set.description: 数轴上表示数 a 的点到原点的距离叫 a 的绝对值，记作 |a|，其值非负。
set.name: The concept and geometric meaning of absolute value
set.nameZh: 绝对值的概念与几何意义

criteria: 能说出数轴的三要素
能判断一条直线是否是数轴
set.description: 规定了原点、正方向和单位长度的直线叫数轴，数轴把数与直线上的点联系起来。
set.name: The Number Line

criteria: 能画出坐标系并描点
能写出点的坐标
set.description: 两条互相垂直、原点重合的数轴构成平面直角坐标系，会根据坐标描点并读出点的坐标。
set.name: The Cartesian Coordinate System and Point Coordinates
set.nameZh: 平面直角坐标系与点的坐标

criteria: 能说出基底需要三个不共面的向量
能判断一组向量能不能作为基底
set.description: 空间中任一向量都可以由三个不共面的向量唯一线性表示。
set.name: Fundamental Theorem of Vectors in Space

set.reason: The actual computational rule can be stated piecewise and gives both solutions of |x|=a for a positive a. Gemini treats the geometry/definition node as unavoidable, but this geometry-specific endpoint is not needed to apply that supplied rule.
set.scope: Geometric distance interpretation as preparation for the piecewise absolute-value computation rule

set.reason: The stated rule for a negative input returns its opposite; solving |x|=a also identifies the opposite pair.
Decomposition identifies the cylinder, cone and sphere pieces.
The cone-volume criterion explicitly uses the one-third base-area-height relation.
Three perpendicular number lines can introduce triples directly without previous plane-pair plotting.
A 3D coordinate system can be built geometrically as three perpendicular number lines through an origin. The vector basis viewpoint later unifies it but is not needed to read triples.

Three-dimensional coordinates require coordinate-axis meaning but can introduce triples directly without prior two-dimensional plotting. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Using origin, orientation and units on each of three coordinate axes

criteria: 能计算棱柱和已知底面积的圆柱体积
能计算已知底面积和高的圆锥体积
set.description: 会用底面积乘高求柱体体积，并用三分之一求锥体体积。
set.name: Volumes of simple solids

criteria: 能指出组合体由哪些基本几何体组成
能分别使用各部分的数量
set.description: 能把简单组合体拆成柱、锥、球，并数出可见的简单个数。
set.name: Simple Composite Solids

criteria: 能熟练求有理数的绝对值
能由 |x|=a 求 x
set.description: 按“正数取本身、负数取相反数、0 取 0”的法则求绝对值并作简单化简。
set.name: Simplifying and calculating absolute values

criteria: 能说出三条坐标轴两两垂直
能读出点的三个坐标
set.description: 空间直角坐标系由原点发出三条两两垂直的数轴，点用有序三元数 (x，y，z) 表示。
set.name: Three-Dimensional Cartesian Coordinate System

criteria: 能说出三角形面积是等底等高平行四边形的一半
能用底×高÷2 求面积
set.description: 会用底乘高除以 2 计算三角形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Triangle

criteria: 能说出圆锥体积等于等底等高圆柱的三分之一
能计算简单的圆锥体积
set.description: 知道圆锥的体积是等底等高圆柱体积的三分之一。
set.name: Volume of a Cone

criteria: 能指出圆柱的母线和高
能说出球的半径
set.description: 能说出圆柱、圆锥、球的主要元素，并和棱柱区分开。
set.name: Cylinders, Cones, and Spheres
scopeNotes: The source description explicitly includes a contrast with prisms, despite rotational-solid-only criteria.
